questions.question: How does David describe the LORD in Psalm 27?
options: My light and my salvation; the stronghold of my life
My portion and my cup; the joy of my heart
My shepherd and my guide; the keeper of my soul
My rock and my refuge; the shield of my hope
questions.answer: My light and my salvation; the stronghold of my life

questions.question: What is the one thing David asks of the LORD?
options: To dwell in the house of the LORD all his days
To defeat all his enemies in battle
To rule over the nations from Zion
To gather to himself great wealth and many children
questions.answer: To dwell in the house of the LORD all his days

questions.question: David says, 'Whom shall I fear?' since the LORD is his salvation.
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and _____.
The LORD is the stronghold of my life — whom shall I _____?
